places.name: Daniel J. Warren Playground off-leash area

places.name: Coolidge Park off-leash area
places.note: Brookline Green Dog program area, grassy and not fenced, with early morning off-leash hours for registered dogs.

places.name: How Park off-leash area

places.name: Arlington Reservoir Beach off-leash hours

places.name: Stodder's Neck

places.name: Randolph Dog Park

places.name: Burlington Dog Park

places.name: Corey Hill Park off-leash area
places.note: Brookline Green Dog off-leash area, for registered dogs from dawn to 9 a.m.

places.name: Hood Park Dog Playground

places.name: Thorndike Field Dog Off-Leash Recreation Area
places.note: Arlington town off-leash recreation area, open 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. daily.

places.name: North Quincy Dog Park

places.name: Dedham Dog Park

places.note: Two fenced off-leash areas for dogs of different sizes, with walking paths nearby. Visitors report dirt ground and no water or bags, so bring your own.

places.name: Millennium Park
places.note: Large West Roxbury park with walking loops, soccer fields and a canoe launch on the Charles. City rules: dogs on a leash of up to eight feet outside designated off-leash spaces.

places.name: The Quiet Few

places.name: Dovetail
places.note: Charlestown Navy Yard restaurant whose seasonal outdoor seating has a designated dog-friendly section.

places.name: The Salty Pig

places.name: Alcove

places.name: Shy Bird Fenway
places.note: Cafe and bar with a dog-friendly outdoor patio.

places.name: Midnight Morning

places.name: Josephine

places.name: Cady Hill Forest

places.name: Sterling Forest

places.name: Stowe Pinnacle trailhead

places.name: Moss Glen Falls

places.note: Short walk to a waterfall in C.C. Putnam State Forest, with parking at the sharp bend on Moss Glen Falls Road. Dogs permitted on leash.

places.name: Mill Trail to Bingham Falls

places.name: Smugglers' Notch State Park

places.name: Elmore State Park and Mount Elmore

places.name: Little River State Park
places.note: Park on the Waterbury Reservoir, open mid May to the third weekend in October. Pets are not allowed on beaches, in swim areas or in most cabins; the Bear cabin takes pets.

places.name: Waterbury Dog Park

places.note: Unfenced off-leash dog field by the Parkway Street lot, no water. Under the 2024 city policy dogs may be off leash on trails in the northern 150 acres of Hubbard Park and must be leashed in the part nearest downtown.

places.name: Wheeler Dog Park
places.note: Fenced, double-gated dog park in Wheeler Nature Park with areas split by energy level, water hoses, benches and shade trees. Open dawn to dusk.

places.name: Farrell Park dog park
places.note: Fenced off-leash dog park with separate sections for large and small dogs. No water and little shade. Parking can be tight on weekdays.

places.name: Starr Farm Dog Park
places.note: Fully fenced grass dog park at the north end of Starr Farm Park with separate large and small dog areas. The city says it can be used year round when the volunteer-run gates are unlocked.

places.name: Mad River Valley Dog Park
places.note: Volunteer-built dog park opened in 2023 past the Warren tennis courts and skate park, by the Eaton Forest trailhead, with separate large and small dog areas and agility structures. No water supply; bring your own.

places.name: Lamoille Valley Rail Trail, Hyde Park trailhead
places.note: Trailhead parking for the Lamoille Valley Rail Trail, a long multi-use rail trail across Lamoille County. Pets permitted on leash.

places.name: The Alchemist Stowe
places.note: Brewery with a beer cafe and a beer garden open daily. Pets are welcome outside only; only trained service dogs inside.

places.name: Idletyme Brewing Company
places.note: Brewery and restaurant on Mountain Road. Dogs are welcome on the outdoor patio.

places.name: von Trapp Brewery and Bierhall
places.note: Brewery and Bierhall with mountain views. A 2023 pet guide says dogs are welcome at the outdoor seating; reviewers say dogs sit outside in the back. Call ahead.

places.name: Stowe Cider
places.note: Cidery and tasting room. Go Stowe says dogs are welcome in the outdoor areas.

places.name: Doc Ponds
places.note: Pub with a dog-friendly outdoor patio.

places.name: Rock Art Brewery
places.note: The brewery says leashed dogs that are friendly with people and other dogs are welcome on the porch and in the downstairs area.

places.name: Prohibition Pig
places.note: Restaurant with its brewery and shop at the back. BringFido lists it as dog friendly, with dogs at the outdoor tables.

places.name: Lawson's Finest Liquids Taproom
places.note: Dogs are welcome only on the Bark Park Patio, not on the main patio or indoors. Service animals welcome.

places.name: Zero Gravity Pine Street Brewery
places.note: Leashed dogs are welcome on the outdoor patio only.

places.name: Black Cap Coffee and Bakery Stowe
places.note: Village coffee shop where dogs can join you at an outdoor table. No table service, so dogs wait outside while you order.

places.name: Ranch Camp
places.note: Restaurant and bike shop where dogs are welcome in the outdoor seating area, per a 2023 pet guide.

places.name: Sushi Yoshi
places.note: Restaurant whose covered, heated outdoor seating is dog friendly, per a 2023 pet guide.

places.name: Shaw's General Store
places.note: Historic general store in Stowe Village. Go Stowe says it welcomes leashed dogs inside.

places.name: Pinnacle Ski and Sports
places.note: Ski, bike and outdoor gear shop. Go Stowe says dogs can come inside while you shop or rent gear.

places.name: Pet Food Warehouse South Burlington
places.note: Local pet food and supply store. A second store is at 2455 Shelburne Road in Shelburne.

places.name: Ben & Jerry's Factory
places.note: Leashed, supervised dogs are welcome on the outdoor grounds. Pets are not allowed inside the factory; service dogs are. Do not leave dogs in the car in warm months.

places.name: Humane Society of Chittenden County
places.note: Animal shelter and adoption center for the Burlington area.

places.name: Central Vermont Humane Society
places.address: 1589 VT Route 14 South, East Montpelier, VT 05651
places.note: Animal shelter and adoption center serving central Vermont.

places.name: Burlington Emergency and Veterinary Specialists
places.note: Vermont's only 24/7 emergency and specialty animal hospital, and the nearest round-the-clock emergency vet to Stowe.

places.name: Stowe Veterinary Clinic
places.note: Veterinary clinic on Route 100 north of Stowe Village.

places.name: Sequist Animal Hospital
places.note: Small animal hospital serving Morrisville since 1980, with medical, surgical and dental care.

places.name: Waterbury Veterinary Hospital
places.note: General practice for small companion animals on Route 100 between Waterbury and Stowe.

places.name: Mad River Veterinary Service
places.note: Veterinary clinic with a large fenced field for walks before or after exams.

places.name: Montpelier Veterinary Hospital
places.note: Veterinary hospital in Montpelier.

places.name: Dogs Etc Grooming and Day Care
places.note: Full grooming, a self-service dog wash, nail trims and dog daycare.
